plotagents

Beautiful charts from one JSON spec. Data and field names go in; an accessible SVG comes out, with careful typography, colorblind-safe colors and tooltips. Built so an AI agent can chart anything without thinking about design: 26 chart types, seaborn's included, time sliders, small multiples and JSON themes.

npm install plotagents
CompareTimeProjectsPart-to-wholeMapsDistributionsRelationshipsNetworks and flowsFlows and numbersTablesConfiguration

Compare 7

Columns

Few short categories become columns, sorted largest first, with the value on each tip and no axis, since the values are already written.

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "Biobío concentra el 30% de las ventas del sur",
  subtitle: "Ventas por región, millones de pesos, 2025",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Biobío", ventas: 1240},
    {region: "Araucanía", ventas: 880},
    // … 4 filas más
  ],
  x: "region",
  y: "ventas"
})

Horizontal bars with highlight

Long labels switch to horizontal bars automatically. highlight emphasizes one category and mutes the rest.

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "Casi tres de cada diez reclamos son por retrasos en la entrega",
  subtitle: "Reclamos recibidos por motivo, enero a junio",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {servicio: "Retraso en la entrega del pedido", casos: 412},
    {servicio: "Cobro duplicado en la tarjeta", casos: 268},
    // … 5 filas más
  ],
  x: "servicio",
  y: "casos",
  highlight: "Retraso en la entrega del pedido"
})

Grouped bars

One color per series, in fixed order. With two or more series the legend is always there.

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "En 2025 el canal online superó por primera vez a la tienda",
  subtitle: "Ventas por canal, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":2022, canal: "Tienda", ventas: 820},
    {"año":2022, canal: "Online", ventas: 310},
    // … 10 filas más
  ],
  x: "año",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "canal"
})

100% stacked

stack: "percent" compares composition. Shares are written inside a segment only when they fit.

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "En Biobío casi 4 de cada 10 pesos se venden online",
  subtitle: "Participación de cada canal en las ventas regionales",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Biobío", canal: "Tienda", ventas: 520},
    {region: "Biobío", canal: "Online", ventas: 480},
    // … 13 filas más
  ],
  x: "region",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "canal",
  stack: "percent",
  horizontal: true
})

Countplot

type: "countplot" counts rows per category, no pre-aggregation needed.

Show code
plot({
  type: "countplot",
  title: "Concepción concentra 60 de 192 respuestas",
  subtitle: "Respuestas de la encuesta por sede",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {sede: "Concepción", canal: "Teléfono", nota: 7},
    {sede: "Concepción", canal: "Presencial", nota: 4.405015014597343},
    // … 190 filas más
  ],
  x: "sede"
})

Estimated columns

On a time axis, dashedFrom hatches the columns from that year on: stripes of the same color and a dashed border. The legend explains the hatching, and hovering it highlights only those columns.

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "De US$ 24,1 mil millones en 2024 a casi US$ 29 mil millones en 2028",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones de fruta fresca, miles de millones de US$",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":2016, valor: 15.2},
    {"año":2017, valor: 18.6},
    // … 11 filas más
  ],
  x: "año",
  y: "valor",
  dashedFrom: 2025,
  dashedLabel: "Estimado",
  format: {
    decimals: 1
  }
})

Provisional figures

dashed: "provisional" reads a data field: rows with a truthy value are drawn dashed. It also takes a list of categories (dashed: ["Biobío"]).

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "Maule lidera la cosecha; tres regiones aún no cierran su cifra",
  subtitle: "Cosecha de cerezas por región, miles de toneladas",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Maule", toneladas: 412, provisional: false},
    {region: "Ñuble", toneladas: 298, provisional: false},
    // … 5 filas más
  ],
  x: "region",
  y: "toneladas",
  horizontal: true,
  dashed: "provisional",
  dashedLabel: "Provisorio"
})

Time 10

Lines with an annotation

Labels always sit at the end of each line; when they collide they are spread apart with a leader line. In the browser a slider narrows the period.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  title: "Ñuble acelera desde la apertura de su nueva sucursal",
  subtitle: "Ventas mensuales por región, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Biobío", ventas: 123},
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Araucanía", ventas: 81},
    // … 142 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "region",
  annotations: [
    {
      x: "2024-01",
      label: "Nueva sucursal en Chillán"
    }
  ]
})

Index = 100 (no dual axis)

Measures on different scales never share two axes: index: true rebases them to 100 so growth can be compared.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  title: "Los clientes crecieron 2,4 veces; la dotación, solo 7%",
  subtitle: "Índice 2018 = 100",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":2018, ingresos: 1180, dotacion: 212, clientes: 3100},
    {"año":2019, ingresos: 1260, dotacion: 220, clientes: 3400},
    // … 6 filas más
  ],
  x: "año",
  y: [
    "clientes",
    "ingresos",
    "dotacion"
  ],
  labelsFor: {
    dotacion: "Dotación"
  },
  index: true,
  refLines: [
    {
      y: 100,
      label: "Base"
    }
  ]
})

Area with a target

One hue at 12% opacity and a reference line for a target, average or threshold.

Show code
plot({
  type: "area",
  title: "El saldo de caja superó la meta en enero de 2025",
  subtitle: "Saldo de caja a fin de mes, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2024-01", saldo: 420},
    {mes: "2024-02", saldo: 457},
    // … 22 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "saldo",
  refLines: [
    {
      y: 600,
      label: "Meta"
    }
  ]
})

100% stacked areas

stack: "percent" shows how each region's share of the total changes over time; labels at the end give the latest share. curve: "smooth" never invents peaks.

Show code
plot({
  type: "area",
  title: "Ñuble pasó de 19% a 27% de las ventas del sur entre 2022 y 2025",
  subtitle: "Participación mensual de cada región en las ventas, %",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Biobío", ventas: 123},
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Araucanía", ventas: 81},
    // … 142 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "region",
  stack: "percent",
  curve: "smooth"
})

Period buttons with play

time: "año" shows one year at a time (the latest by default); every tile shows its change vs the previous year and colors follow each sector across years. Controls are opt-in: slider: true adds buttons when there are few periods and a minimal slider when there are many; "buttons" or "slider" force one, play: false hides play.

Show code
plot({
  type: "treemap",
  slider: true,
  title: "El cobre bajó de 67% a 55% de las exportaciones",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones por sector y producto, miles de millones de US$",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":2018, sector: "Minería", producto: "Cobre", valor: 68.65},
    {"año":2018, sector: "Minería", producto: "Litio", valor: 1.33},
    // … 158 filas más
  ],
  path: [
    "sector",
    "producto"
  ],
  value: "valor",
  time: "año"
})

Treemap colored by change

With time, every tile shows its share and its change vs the previous period; colorBy: "change" paints growth in the cool hue and decline in the warm one.

Show code
plot({
  type: "treemap",
  slider: "buttons",
  play: false,
  title: "El litio y las cerezas crecen más rápido que el resto",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones por sector y producto, variación anual",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":2018, sector: "Minería", producto: "Cobre", valor: 68.65},
    {"año":2018, sector: "Minería", producto: "Litio", valor: 1.33},
    // … 158 filas más
  ],
  path: [
    "sector",
    "producto"
  ],
  value: "valor",
  time: "año",
  colorBy: "change"
})

Small multiples (facet)

facet: "region" draws one panel per region on the same scale with the same colors (seaborn col / col_wrap). Better than tangled lines.

Show code
plot({
  type: "area",
  title: "Las tres regiones crecen, Ñuble desde una base menor",
  subtitle: "Ventas mensuales, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Biobío", ventas: 123},
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Araucanía", ventas: 81},
    // … 142 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "ventas",
  facet: "region",
  columns: 3
})

Log scale

yScale: "log": exponential growth looks straight, so rates can be compared instead of levels. 1-2-5 ticks, no empty decades.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  title: "Los usuarios de la app se multiplicaron por 176 en cuatro años",
  subtitle: "Usuarios activos mensuales, escala logarítmica",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", plataforma: "App móvil", usuarios: 604},
    {mes: "2022-01", plataforma: "Sitio web", usuarios: 5581},
    // … 94 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "usuarios",
  series: "plataforma",
  yScale: "log"
})

Line with a projection

dashedFrom: 2025 draws the projected stretch with a dashed stroke and hollow points over a soft band labeled with dashedLabel. Solid and dashed meet at the last firm value; the tooltip says which values are projected.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  title: "Las exportaciones llegarían a US$ 29 mil millones en 2028",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones de fruta fresca, miles de millones de US$",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":2016, valor: 15.2},
    {"año":2017, valor: 18.6},
    // … 11 filas más
  ],
  x: "año",
  y: "valor",
  dashedFrom: 2025,
  dashedLabel: "Proyección",
  points: true,
  format: {
    decimals: 1
  }
})

Stacked areas with a projection

In stacked areas, the stretch from dashedFrom is hatched in each series' color: the composition still reads, but it is clearly an estimate.

Show code
plot({
  type: "area",
  title: "La venta web superaría a la tienda desde 2025",
  subtitle: "Ventas por canal, millones de $",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":"2021", canal: "Tienda", ventas: 410},
    {"año":"2021", canal: "Web", ventas: 120},
    // … 10 filas más
  ],
  x: "año",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "canal",
  dashedFrom: "2025",
  dashedLabel: "Estimación"
})

Projects 3

Gantt chart

Tasks with start and end, grouped by phase with group. The filled part is the progress (progress), diamonds are milestones, arrows come from dependsOn and today marks where we are. Tentative work is hatched with dashed.

Show code
plot({
  type: "gantt",
  title: "El proyecto llega a producción el 15 de junio; la integración con el ERP es la ruta crítica",
  subtitle: "Plan de trabajo por fase, 2026. La parte llena de cada barra es el avance",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {fase: "Diagnóstico", tarea: "Entrevistas con usuarios", inicio: "2026-01-05", fin: "2026-01-23", avance: 100},
    {fase: "Diagnóstico", tarea: "Mapa de procesos", inicio: "2026-01-19", fin: "2026-02-06", avance: 100, depende: "Entrevistas con usuarios"},
    // … 8 filas más
  ],
  task: "tarea",
  start: "inicio",
  end: "fin",
  group: "fase",
  progress: "avance",
  dependsOn: "depende",
  milestone: "hito",
  today: "2026-03-12",
  dashed: "tentativo",
  dashedLabel: "Por confirmar"
})

Schedule in weeks

No dates: start as a week number and duration in weeks. With groupHeaders: false teams go in a color legend, and highlight brings one forward.

Show code
plot({
  type: "gantt",
  title: "Marketing concentra su trabajo en las últimas seis semanas del lanzamiento",
  subtitle: "Cronograma de lanzamiento por equipo, semanas desde el inicio",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {equipo: "Producto", tarea: "Definir alcance", semana: 1, semanas: 2},
    {equipo: "Diseño", tarea: "Identidad y empaque", semana: 2, semanas: 4},
    // … 5 filas más
  ],
  task: "tarea",
  start: "semana",
  duration: "semanas",
  group: "equipo",
  groupHeaders: false,
  highlight: "Marketing",
  xLabel: "Semana"
})

Collapsible phases and critical path

With collapsed a phase rolls up into one row: its duration-weighted progress and its milestones (true collapses them all). In the browser, a click on the phase opens or closes it. critical: true marks the critical path, the tasks with no slack; short plans shade weekends.

Show code
plot({
  type: "gantt",
  title: "La apertura del 22 de junio no tiene holgura: un día de atraso en la climatización la mueve",
  subtitle: "Plan de ampliación de la sucursal por fase, 2026. Permisos, ya cerrada, va contraída; la parte llena es el avance",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {fase: "Permisos", tarea: "Levantamiento del local", inicio: "2026-03-02", fin: "2026-03-06", avance: 100},
    {fase: "Permisos", tarea: "Planos y especificaciones", inicio: "2026-03-09", fin: "2026-03-20", avance: 100, depende: "Levantamiento del local"},
    // … 12 filas más
  ],
  task: "tarea",
  start: "inicio",
  end: "fin",
  group: "fase",
  progress: "avance",
  dependsOn: "depende",
  today: "2026-04-15",
  collapsed: [
    "Permisos"
  ],
  critical: true
})

Part-to-whole 7

Three-level treemap

Sector › subsector › product with path. Areas are exact (no header bands), one solid color per sector, wider gaps between sectors than inside them, and a legend with each sector's share. Hover the legend to light up a sector.

Show code
plot({
  type: "treemap",
  title: "El cobre por sí solo explica el 54% de las exportaciones",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones por sector, subsector y producto, miles de millones de US$",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {sector: "Minería", subsector: "Metálica", producto: "Cobre", valor: 50.1},
    {sector: "Minería", subsector: "Metálica", producto: "Molibdeno", valor: 3.1},
    // … 23 filas más
  ],
  path: [
    "sector",
    "subsector",
    "producto"
  ],
  value: "valor"
})

Treemap with focus (drill-down)

focus: ["Agro"] shows only that branch, keeping its colors, with breadcrumbs to go back. In the browser, a click on a group does the same.

Show code
plot({
  type: "treemap",
  title: "Dentro del agro, la fruta fresca suma el 73%",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones agropecuarias por subsector y producto, miles de millones de US$",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {sector: "Minería", subsector: "Metálica", producto: "Cobre", valor: 50.1},
    {sector: "Minería", subsector: "Metálica", producto: "Molibdeno", valor: 3.1},
    // … 23 filas más
  ],
  path: [
    "sector",
    "subsector",
    "producto"
  ],
  value: "valor",
  focus: [
    "Agro"
  ]
})

Sunburst

The same hierarchy as rings: the inner ring is level 1 and outer rings inherit its color. Total in the center. Click to drill in.

Show code
plot({
  type: "sunburst",
  title: "Docencia concentra el 49% del presupuesto",
  subtitle: "Presupuesto por área, unidad e ítem, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {area: "Docencia", unidad: "Pregrado", item: "Remuneraciones", monto: 2100},
    {area: "Docencia", unidad: "Pregrado", item: "Operación", monto: 520},
    // … 17 filas más
  ],
  path: [
    "area",
    "unidad",
    "item"
  ],
  value: "monto",
  format: "currency"
})

Pie

Percentages inside each slice and a legend table beside it. Six parts at most.

Show code
plot({
  type: "pie",
  title: "Hidroeléctrica y solar generan casi la mitad de la electricidad",
  subtitle: "Generación eléctrica por fuente, % del total anual",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {fuente: "Hidroeléctrica", gwh: 27},
    {fuente: "Solar", gwh: 22},
    // … 4 filas más
  ],
  label: "fuente",
  value: "gwh"
})

Donut with outside labels

labels: "outside" puts name and percentage outside, with leader lines that never collide.

Show code
plot({
  type: "donut",
  title: "Docencia e investigación suman el 73% del presupuesto",
  subtitle: "Presupuesto 2025 por área, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {area: "Docencia", monto: 4200},
    {area: "Investigación", monto: 2600},
    // … 4 filas más
  ],
  label: "area",
  value: "monto",
  format: "currency",
  labels: "outside"
})

Half donut

half: true draws a semicircle with the total on the baseline. Good for simple shares in little height.

Show code
plot({
  type: "donut",
  half: true,
  title: "El canal online ya vende más que la tienda",
  subtitle: "Ventas 2025 por canal, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {canal: "Online", ventas: 780},
    {canal: "Tienda", ventas: 740},
    // … 1 filas más
  ],
  label: "canal",
  value: "ventas",
  format: "currency"
})

Donut with an estimated part

A dashed segment keeps its color and place, with hatching and an inner dashed border; its swatch in the table-legend is hatched too.

Show code
plot({
  type: "donut",
  title: "Las remuneraciones son casi la mitad del gasto",
  subtitle: "Gasto operacional por partida, millones de $",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {partida: "Remuneraciones", monto: 4620},
    {partida: "Arriendo", monto: 1810},
    // … 3 filas más
  ],
  label: "partida",
  value: "monto",
  dashed: "Sin clasificar",
  dashedLabel: "Estimado",
  format: {
    prefix: "$",
    suffix: " M"
  }
})

Maps 13

Chile choropleth

Regions matched by name, code or alias ("RM", "Biobio", "Aisén"). The map sits on the left and a north-to-south column shows name, bar and value.

Show code
plot({
  type: "choropleth",
  geo: "chile",
  title: "El sur austral tiene el menor desempleo: 3,8% en Magallanes",
  subtitle: "Tasa de desocupación por región, %",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Arica y Parinacota", tasa: 8.9},
    {region: "Tarapacá", tasa: 7.8},
    // … 14 filas más
  ],
  key: "region",
  value: "tasa",
  format: {
    suffix: "%",
    decimals: 1
  },
  legendTitle: "Desocupación"
})

Diverging map

With midpoint: 0 the scale diverges: one color for gains, another for losses and a neutral gray near zero.

Show code
plot({
  type: "choropleth",
  geo: "chile",
  title: "10 de 16 regiones aumentaron su empleo en el año",
  subtitle: "Variación anual de ocupados, %",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Arica y Parinacota", variacion: -1.8},
    {region: "Tarapacá", variacion: 0.6},
    // … 14 filas más
  ],
  key: "region",
  value: "variacion",
  midpoint: 0,
  format: {
    suffix: "%",
    decimals: 1
  },
  legendTitle: "Variación"
})

Proportional symbol map

For absolute amounts (people, money) the circle area is proportional to the value; coloring regions misleads when their sizes differ.

Show code
plot({
  type: "symbolmap",
  geo: "chile",
  title: "La Región Metropolitana concentra el 42% de los habitantes",
  subtitle: "Población por región",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Arica y Parinacota", habitantes: 253000},
    {region: "Tarapacá", habitantes: 391000},
    // … 14 filas más
  ],
  key: "region",
  value: "habitantes",
  format: "compact"
})

World map

Equal Earth projection (true areas). Countries by ISO-3 code, Spanish or English name. missing: "plain" leaves countries without data unhatched.

Show code
plot({
  type: "choropleth",
  geo: "world",
  title: "China compra el 51% del cobre exportado",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones de cobre por destino, miles de millones de US$",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {iso3: "CHN", valor: 26.1},
    {iso3: "JPN", valor: 4.6},
    // … 19 filas más
  ],
  key: "iso3",
  value: "valor",
  missing: "plain",
  labels: 4,
  format: {
    prefix: "US$",
    decimals: 1
  },
  legendTitle: "Miles de millones"
})

United States map

geo: "usa": 50 states, DC and Puerto Rico in an Albers projection with Alaska and Hawaii insets. States match by postal code, English or Spanish name, or FIPS code. Small northeastern states get labels outside with leader lines. dashed hatches the ones with preliminary figures. In the browser: click a state to zoom in, Ctrl + scroll or pinch to zoom, drag to pan.

Show code
plot({
  type: "choropleth",
  geo: "usa",
  title: "Idaho creció más rápido (8,9%) y 12 estados perdieron población",
  subtitle: "Variación de la población 2020–2024, %",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {estado: "AL", crecimiento: 2.1, preliminar: false},
    {estado: "AK", crecimiento: -0.4, preliminar: false},
    // … 49 filas más
  ],
  key: "estado",
  value: "crecimiento",
  midpoint: 0,
  dashed: "preliminar",
  dashedLabel: "Cifra preliminar",
  format: {
    suffix: "%",
    decimals: 1
  },
  legendTitle: "Variación"
})

Map with a time slider

time: "año" shows one year at a time; slider: true adds the controls and, with play, each state's color glides into the next year's. The color scale stays fixed across years (scale with breaks) so colors are comparable.

Show code
plot({
  type: "choropleth",
  geo: "usa",
  time: "año",
  slider: true,
  title: "El desempleo saltó en 2020 en todos los estados y volvió a su nivel en 2022",
  subtitle: "Tasa de desempleo por estado, %",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {estado: "AL","año":2019, tasa: 2.5},
    {estado: "AL","año":2020, tasa: 6.5},
    // … 304 filas más
  ],
  key: "estado",
  value: "tasa",
  scale: [
    3,

  ],
  format: {
    suffix: "%",
    decimals: 1
  },
  legendTitle: "Desempleo"
})

US proportional symbol map

For totals, area-proportional circles on each state. The size legend sits on top, in a row, so it never collides with the Alaska and Hawaii insets.

Show code
plot({
  type: "symbolmap",
  geo: "usa",
  title: "Cuatro estados reúnen el 34% de la población",
  subtitle: "Habitantes por estado, 2024",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {estado: "AL", habitantes: 5100000},
    {estado: "AK", habitantes: 700000},
    // … 49 filas más
  ],
  key: "estado",
  value: "habitantes",
  format: "compact",
  labels: [
    "CA",
    "TX",
    "FL",
    "NY"
  ]
})

Your own GeoJSON

Pass any GeoJSON or TopoJSON in geo. The property that matches your data is detected for you (here ADMIN); a text value colors by category. markers adds points by lon/lat and layers overlays lines.

Framing and markers

fitTo frames a few regions (or a [lon, lat, lon, lat] box) and keeps the rest as context. Markers with size get an area proportional to the value.

Show code
plot({
  type: "choropleth",
  geo: "chile",
  title: "Biobío exporta más que sus tres vecinas juntas, y lo hace por tres puertos",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones por región, miles de millones de US$, y carga por puerto, millones de toneladas",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Maule", mm: 3.1},
    {region: "Ñuble", mm: 1.2},
    // … 2 filas más
  ],
  key: "region",
  value: "mm",
  legendTitle: "Exportaciones",
  format: {
    decimals: 1
  },
  fitTo: [
    "Biobío",
    "Ñuble"
  ],
  markers: {
    data: [
      {
        puerto: "Talcahuano y San Vicente",
        lon: -73.12,
        lat: -36.72,
        mt: 10.9
      },
      {
        puerto: "Coronel",
        lon: -73.16,
        lat: -37.03,
        mt: 7.4
      },
      {
        puerto: "Lirquén",
        lon: -72.97,
        lat: -36.71,
        mt: 4.1
      }
    ],
    label: "puerto",
    size: "mt",
    legend: "Puerto (área ∝ toneladas)",
    color: "#E8A33D",
    maxRadius: 16
  },
  missing: "plain"
})

Point map over a basemap

type: "pointmap" draws lon/lat points over a real basemap (OpenStreetMap by default), muted so the data leads. size sets each circle's area; the size key sits in a corner and the largest cities are named. In the browser: click, Ctrl + scroll or pinch to zoom.

Show code
plot({
  type: "pointmap",
  title: "Santiago reúne el 52% de los habitantes de las 30 mayores ciudades",
  subtitle: "Habitantes por ciudad, aproximado",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {ciudad: "Santiago", lat: -33.45, lon: -70.66, habitantes: 6310000, macrozona: "Centro", variacion: 8.1},
    {ciudad: "Concepción", lat: -36.82, lon: -73.05, habitantes: 985000, macrozona: "Sur", variacion: 4.2},
    // … 28 filas más
  ],
  lon: "lon",
  lat: "lat",
  size: "habitantes",
  label: "ciudad",
  format: "compact"
})

Points by category

hue colors by category with the theme palette and a linked legend. At city scale the zoom rises on its own (about 12 here) and the tiles show streets.

Show code
plot({
  type: "pointmap",
  title: "4 de las 7 tiendas están fuera del centro de Concepción",
  subtitle: "Sucursales del Gran Concepción por tipo de local",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {sucursal: "Centro", lat: -36.827, lon: -73.05, tipo: "Tienda", ventas: 182},
    {sucursal: "Mall Plaza Trébol", lat: -36.792, lon: -73.068, tipo: "Tienda", ventas: 241},
    // … 14 filas más
  ],
  lon: "lon",
  lat: "lat",
  hue: "tipo",
  label: "sucursal",
  labels: [
    "Centro",
    "Talcahuano",
    "San Pedro de la Paz",
    "Coronel",
    "Tomé",
    "Chiguayante"
  ]
})

Value ramp on the dark theme

A numeric value colors along a sequential ramp. On the noche theme the tiles are inverted and tinted navy; tileStyle: "original" leaves them as they come.

Show code
plot({
  type: "pointmap",
  theme: "noche",
  title: "Las ciudades del norte crecieron 7,8% en promedio; Alto Hospicio, 14,1%",
  subtitle: "Variación de la población 2017–2024, %; tamaño según habitantes",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {ciudad: "Santiago", lat: -33.45, lon: -70.66, habitantes: 6310000, macrozona: "Centro", variacion: 8.1},
    {ciudad: "Concepción", lat: -36.82, lon: -73.05, habitantes: 985000, macrozona: "Sur", variacion: 4.2},
    // … 28 filas más
  ],
  lon: "lon",
  lat: "lat",
  size: "habitantes",
  value: "variacion",
  label: "ciudad",
  valueFormat: {
    suffix: "%",
    decimals: 1
  },
  sizeFormat: "compact",
  legendTitle: "Variación"
})

Another basemap

tiles picks the basemap: "osm", "esri-gray", "esri-dark", "carto-light", "carto-dark", "mapbox-light" / "mapbox-dark" (with tilesKey: "pk.…") or your own { url, attribution }. The attribution is always drawn, with a link.

Show code
plot({
  type: "pointmap",
  locale: "en",
  tiles: "esri-gray",
  title: "São Paulo, Buenos Aires and Rio hold 38% of the people in these 24 metro areas",
  subtitle: "Population of the largest South American metro areas",
  source: "illustrative data",
  data: [
    {city: "São Paulo", lat: -23.55, lon: -46.63, population: 22400000, country: "Brazil"},
    {city: "Buenos Aires", lat: -34.6, lon: -58.38, population: 15600000, country: "Argentina"},
    // … 22 filas más
  ],
  lon: "lon",
  lat: "lat",
  size: "population",
  highlight: [
    "São Paulo",
    "Buenos Aires",
    "Rio de Janeiro"
  ],
  label: "city",
  format: "compact"
})

Distributions 14

Line with a confidence band

ci: true (seaborn lineplot): with several observations per x, it draws the mean and its 95% interval. errorbar: "sd" also works.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  title: "Entre semana la espera tiene dos peaks: 10:00 y 18:00",
  subtitle: "Minutos de espera promedio por hora, con intervalo de confianza de 95%",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {hora: 8, dia: "Laboral", minutos: 3.4348942318371343},
    {hora: 8, dia: "Fin de semana", minutos: 7.693086451248866},
    // … 648 filas más
  ],
  x: "hora",
  y: "minutos",
  series: "dia",
  ci: true,
  xLabel: "Hora del día"
})

Barplot with intervals

type: "barplot" (or ci: true): mean per category with error bars. The tooltip shows the interval.

Show code
plot({
  type: "barplot",
  title: "Concepción tiene la mejor nota de satisfacción: 5,5",

  ],
  x: "sede",
  y: "nota",
  series: "canal",
  sort: "none"
})

Histogram with density

Nice bin widths from Freedman–Diaconis and a KDE curve on the same scale.

Show code

  type: "hist",

Overlapping histograms

hue splits groups; multiple: "layer" overlaps them with transparency. Also "stack", "dodge" and "fill".

Show code

Density by group

Filled density curves, one per area, each named over its peak. xScale: "log" also works.

Cumulative distribution

Answers "what share is below this value?" without choosing bin widths. The median is marked.

Box plot

Median, quartiles and whiskers at 1.5 × IQR; outliers as hollow dots. Long labels switch to horizontal.

Split violin

Mirrored density (KDE) per group. With two hue levels and split: true, each half is a group; inside, the IQR and median.

Strip plot

Every observation is a point with deterministic jitter; the bar marks the group mean.

Population pyramid

Back-to-back bars from a central axis; age groups sit in the middle column, with no duplicated axes. Each side is named, with its share, in its own color.

Relationships 9

Bubbles with a trend

Size is area-proportional to population. Only the points that matter are labeled, plus a least-squares line with R².

Show code

  title: "A mayor ingreso por persona, mayor uso de internet",

    "Brasil",
    "Alemania",
    "Bolivia",
    "México"

  xLabel: "PIB per cápita (miles US$)",

})

Regression with confidence band

Points, fitted line and a 95% band for the mean. annotate adds R² and n.

Regression on a log axis

logx: true fits y ~ log(x) and draws a log x axis. With hue, one fit per group named at its end.

Residuals

To check a fit: residuals should scatter around zero with no pattern. lowess shows the trend.

Show code

  lowess: true,
  xLabel: "Horas de estudio por semana"
})

Correlation matrix

Each pair once, below the diagonal, on a fixed diverging scale from −1 to 1. alpha: 0.05 greys out correlations that are not significant; method: "spearman" uses ranks.

Show code
plot({
  type: "corr",
  title: "En los barrios con más escolaridad el ingreso es mayor (r = 0,85) y la pobreza menor (r = −0,81)",
  subtitle: "Correlación de Pearson entre ocho indicadores de 120 barrios",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {zona: "Centro", ingreso: 875, escolaridad: 12, pobreza: 8.6, hacinamiento: 9.5, areas_verdes: 3.3, densidad: 4652, tiempo_viaje: 31, edad_media: 36.6},
    {zona: "Oriente", ingreso: 1746, escolaridad: 16.2, pobreza: 1.9, hacinamiento: 0.4, areas_verdes: 8.8, densidad: 5512, tiempo_viaje: 29, edad_media: 40.3},
    // … 118 filas más
  ],
  vars: [
    "ingreso",
    "escolaridad",
    "pobreza",
    "hacinamiento",
    "areas_verdes",
    "densidad",
    "tiempo_viaje",
    "edad_media"
  ],
  labelsFor: {
    ingreso: "Ingreso",
    escolaridad: "Escolaridad",
    pobreza: "Pobreza",
    hacinamiento: "Hacinamiento",
    areas_verdes: "Áreas verdes",
    densidad: "Densidad",
    tiempo_viaje: "Tiempo de viaje",
    edad_media: "Edad media"
  },
  alpha: 0.05
})

Collaboration network

Click a node: it glides to the center with its connections highlighted (click again or press Esc to go back). Deterministic force layout. Size = projects (weighted degree), color = kind of organization; the largest are labeled. highlight keeps one node and its neighbors in view.

Circular network

layout: "circle" orders nodes by group around a circle; links curve toward the center. Good for small, dense networks.

Character network

In the style of the ECharts *Les Misérables* graph: curved links in the color of the source character, node area ∝ shared scenes and non-overlapping names (the largest are labeled; the rest are in the tooltip). curveness sets the bend (0 = straight).

Radial tree

layout: "radial": a tree from the most connected node (or from focus): each ring is one more step away. Links outside the tree are faint.

Concentric network

layout: "concentric": rings by weight, the largest in the middle; within each ring, ordered by group. Who concentrates the network shows at a glance.

Chord diagram

Each arc is a zone's total; each ribbon, the exchange between two zones (the tooltip splits both directions). Ribbons take the color of the zone that sends more.

Show code
plot({
  type: "chord",
  title: "Metropolitana y Centro intercambian más personas que cualquier otro par: 135.000",
  subtitle: "Cambios de residencia entre macrozonas en cinco años",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {origen: "Norte Grande", destino: "Norte Chico", personas: 9000},
    {origen: "Norte Grande", destino: "Centro", personas: 6000},
    // … 28 filas más
  ],
  from: "origen",
  to: "destino",
  value: "personas"
})

Flow chart with swimlanes

Nodes and edges with a type (start, process, decision, end) and a lane per unit. Layout is automatic; decisions branch from the side and loops go around without crossing nodes.

Show code
plot({
  type: "flowchart",
  title: "Una compra pública pasa por 3 unidades y 2 decisiones antes del pago",
  subtitle: "Proceso de compra, esquema ilustrativo",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  nodes: [
    {
      id: "inicio",
      label: "Necesidad de compra",
      type: "start",
      lane: "Unidad requirente"
    },
    {
      id: "req",

      lane: "Unidad requirente",
      detail: "Incluye presupuesto estimado y criterios de evaluación."
    },
    {
      id: "presup",
      label: "¿Hay disponibilidad presupuestaria?",
      type: "decision",

    },

      lane: "Unidad requirente"
    },
    {

Flows and numbers 4

Heatmap

A single-hue sequential ramp. Values are written in the cell when they fit, in white or ink depending on contrast.

Show code
plot({
  type: "heatmap",
  title: "Los lunes a mediodía se concentra la demanda de atención",
  subtitle: "Atenciones promedio por día y hora",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {dia: "Lun", hora: "08:00", atenciones: 93},
    {dia: "Lun", hora: "10:00", atenciones: 130},
    // … 47 filas más
  ],
  x: "hora",
  y: "dia",
  value: "atenciones"
})

Indicators (KPI)

When the story is a number, the number is the chart. Change with arrow and text, a sparkline and a target meter.

Show code
plot({
  type: "kpi",
  title: "El trimestre cierra con ventas 12% sobre el año anterior",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  items: [
    {label: "Ventas", value: 1250000000, format: "currency", delta: 0.124, period: "vs T3 2025", trend: [8.1,8.6,8.4,9.8,10.9,12.5]},
    {label: "Clientes activos", value: 8420, delta: -0.032, period: "vs T3 2025", trend: [9,8.9,8.7,8.6,8.5,8.4]},
    {label: "Costo por cliente", value: 18500, format: "currency", delta: -0.08, good: "down", period: "vs T3 2025"},
    {label: "Satisfacción (NPS)", value: 62, target: 70, delta: 0.05, period: "vs T3 2025"}
  ]
})

Word cloud

Every word horizontal; each word's area is proportional to its frequency, placed in a spiral from the most frequent, without collisions and identical for the same spec. One hue that darkens with frequency. With text: "…" it counts the words in raw text, dropping stopwords.

Show code
plot({
  type: "wordcloud",
  title: "“Datos” e “inteligencia artificial” dominan lo que piden las empresas",
  subtitle: "Menciones en 312 respuestas abiertas sobre prioridades digitales, 2026",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {palabra: "datos", menciones: 120},
    {palabra: "inteligencia artificial", menciones: 96},
    // … 33 filas más
  ],
  text: "palabra",
  value: "menciones"
})

Word cloud by theme

With series each word takes its theme's color, with a legend: color carries meaning instead of decorating.

Show code
plot({
  type: "wordcloud",
  title: "Las peticiones de tecnología superan a las de personas y negocio",
  subtitle: "Menciones por tema en 312 respuestas abiertas, 2026",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {palabra: "datos", menciones: 120, tema: "Tecnología"},
    {palabra: "inteligencia artificial", menciones: 96, tema: "Tecnología"},
    // … 33 filas más
  ],
  text: "palabra",
  value: "menciones",
  series: "tema"
})

Tables 3

Table with indicators

Without columns, each column picks its indicator: a bar on the main measure, ▲/▼ on the change, a sparkline on lists of numbers, a meter on the target and a pill on the status (statuses are recognized in Spanish, English, Portuguese, French and German). Numbers right-aligned with matching decimals. On a phone, each row becomes a card.

Show code
plot({
  type: "table",
  title: "La Metropolitana vende más que las siete regiones siguientes juntas",
  subtitle: "Ventas 2025 en millones de pesos, variación anual, tendencia 2020–2025 y cumplimiento de la meta",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Metropolitana", ventas: 18420, variacion: 0.041, tendencia: [15.1,15.8,16.4,17.2,17.7,18.4], meta: 0.96, estado: "Completado"},
    {region: "Valparaíso", ventas: 4210, variacion: 0.021, tendencia: [3.7,3.8,3.9,4,4.1,4.2], meta: 0.88, estado: "En curso"},
    // … 6 filas más
  ],
  highlight: "Ñuble",
  total: true
})

Paginated table, in English

More than 15 rows are paginated 10 at a time; the pager uses only numbers and arrows. Without locale, the language is recognized from the title and the data (English here: 1,234.5). In the browser a click on a header sorts, and a search box appears above 20 rows.

Show code
plot({
  type: "table",
  title: "Guyana grew five times faster than any other economy in the region",
  subtitle: "Real GDP growth and inflation, percent, 2024; population in millions",
  source: "illustrative data",
  data: [
    {country: "Guyana", region: "Caribbean", growth: 33.9, inflation: 2.1, population: 0.83},
    {country: "Panama", region: "Central America", growth: 7.3, inflation: 1.1, population: 4.4},
    // … 16 filas más
  ],
  columns: [
    "country",
    "region",
    {
      field: "growth",
      label: "GDP growth",
      type: "delta",
      format: {
        type: "percent",
        scale: 1,
        decimals: 1
      }
    },
    {
      field: "inflation",
      label: "Inflation",
      type: "heat",
      colorScale: "Oranges",
      format: {
        type: "percent",
        scale: 1,
        decimals: 1
      }
    },
    {
      field: "population",
      label: "Population (M)",
      type: "bar",
      format: {
        decimals: 1
      }
    }
  ],
  sortBy: "growth",
  rank: true
})

Project portfolio

columns sets order and type: progress against a target field (with good: "down" going over is bad), check for booleans and readable dates. group puts rows under a band.

Show code
plot({
  type: "table",
  title: "Dos de seis proyectos ya gastaron más de lo presupuestado",
  subtitle: "Cartera digital 2026: avance, gasto contra presupuesto (millones de pesos) y estado",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {proyecto: "Migración ERP", area: "Finanzas", entrega: "2026-03-31", avance: 0.82, estado: "En curso", presupuesto: 410, gasto: 380, prioritario: true},
    {proyecto: "Portal de clientes", area: "Comercial", entrega: "2026-02-15", avance: 1, estado: "Completado", presupuesto: 220, gasto: 205, prioritario: true},
    // … 4 filas más
  ],
  columns: [
    "proyecto",
    "area",
    {
      field: "entrega",
      label: "Entrega"
    },
    {
      field: "avance",
      type: "progress"
    },
    {
      field: "gasto",
      label: "Gasto / presupuesto",

  ],
  sortBy: "avance"
})

Configuration 3

Dark theme + highlight

theme: "noche" uses the same hues, re-stepped and validated for a dark surface. highlight mutes the rest.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  theme: "noche",
  title: "Ñuble creció 60% en dos años, el triple que Biobío",
  subtitle: "Ventas mensuales por región, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Biobío", ventas: 123},
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Araucanía", ventas: 81},
    // … 142 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "region",
  highlight: "Ñuble"
})

Font and text scale

font: "Poppins" and textScale: 1.6 enlarge every text for a presentation and the layout is recomputed. configure({ font, textScale }) sets them for every chart.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  title: "Ñuble crece más rápido que el resto del sur",
  subtitle: "Ventas mensuales, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Biobío", ventas: 123},
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Araucanía", ventas: 81},
    // … 142 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "region",
  font: "Poppins",
  textScale: 1.6
})

Themes are JSON

Colors, type, line weight, radii and axes are one JSON object. palette takes a name ("okabe-ito", "tableau10", "udec") or a list of colors; validatePalette() checks it.

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "Biobío y Araucanía suman la mitad de las ventas del sur",
  subtitle: "Ventas por región y canal, 2025",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Biobío", canal: "Tienda", ventas: 86},
    {region: "Biobío", canal: "Online", ventas: 58},
    // … 4 filas más
  ],
  x: "region",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "canal",
  stack: true,
  theme: {
    extends: "papel",
    categorical: "okabe-ito",
    surface: "#FFFFFF",
    type: {
      title: 22,
      titleWeight: 700
    },
    marks: {
      barRadius: 8,
      barMax: 44
    }
  }
})
All data in this gallery is illustrative. Chart text uses the default Spanish (Chile) locale; set locale: "en" for English formats. Hover for values, drag the time sliders, and click a treemap or sunburst group to drill down. The page follows your system's light or dark mode.
